home.title: Controls that test themselves
home.body: Every control maps to an automated check that runs against your cloud accounts, code hosts and HR system on a schedule you set — not a screenshot someone took in March.

home.title: Evidence collected on the way past
home.body: Meridian watches the systems your team already uses and files the evidence as work happens, so nobody spends the last fortnight before an audit chasing tickets.

home.title: Drift caught in hours, not quarters
home.body: A public bucket, a missed offboarding, an unreviewed production change — you hear about it the same day, with the owner and the remediation already attached.

home.title: One control set, many frameworks
home.body: SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and GDPR share most of their requirements. Satisfy a control once and Meridian credits it everywhere it applies.

home.title: Built for the people doing the work
home.body: Tasks land in Jira and Slack with the context an engineer needs. No parallel portal that only the compliance lead ever opens.

home.title: Auditor-ready by default
home.body: Give your auditor scoped read-only access. They pull evidence themselves, which is how a six-week fieldwork window turns into nine days.

product.title: Control library
product.body: 184 pre-mapped controls across five frameworks, each with an owner, a test, a cadence and a plain-English description your board can read.

product.title: Automated evidence
product.body: Continuous collection from AWS, GCP, Azure, GitHub, GitLab, Okta, Jamf, BambooHR and 40 more, with a documented API for anything in-house.

product.title: Drift monitoring
product.body: Checks run hourly or daily. Failures open a ticket against the owning team with severity, affected resources and a suggested fix.

product.title: Personnel and access
product.body: Onboarding, offboarding, background checks, policy acceptance and access reviews tracked against your HR system of record.

product.title: Vendor management
product.body: Risk-tier your suppliers, store their reports, and get told when a critical vendor's SOC 2 is about to lapse.

product.title: Auditor workspace
product.body: Scoped, read-only, time-boxed access with a full request log — so evidence handover stops living in a shared drive.
